item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, edge-to-edge nonrepresentational abstract painting with no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting. Evoke an inner field of attention as shifting pressure, rhythm, and unresolved motion, without depicting a literal mind or anything recognizable. Build a dense core of layered ultramarine, deep violet, and near-black, cut through by sharp streaks of warm vermilion and pale mineral gold. Let broad, rough brush gestures collide with fine scratches, translucent washes, scraped passages, and granular pigment. Balance compressed clusters and abrupt contrast with a few generous areas of quiet, open color; keep the composition asymmetrical and alive with spatial tension. Let some marks surge, snag, repeat, and fade, creating an uneven rhythm across the full canvas. Purely abstract painting only: no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}
